help.title: Help & FAQs
help.subtitle: Practical help for shopping, payments, delivery and after-sales support on DigitalHood.
highlights: For a purchase, open the order and choose Report an issue so the seller and support can see its history.
Keep your order and case numbers. Never share passwords, payment PINs, OTPs or full card details.

sections.title: How do I buy?
body: Choose a product, check its seller, condition, options, stock and warranty, then add it to your cart. Review the delivery address, charges and total before confirming checkout. Items from different sellers may be delivered separately.

sections.title: My payment is pending or failed
body: An order number or payment prompt is not proof of payment. Check the payment status on your order before trying again. If your wallet or bank was debited but the order is unconfirmed, report it from that order with the payment reference; do not pay a second time while it is being checked.

sections.title: Where is my order?
body: Open Track order or your order history to see the latest available progress and delivery estimate. If the estimate has passed, an item is missing or the status says delivered but you have not received it, report the issue promptly.

sections.title: Can I cancel, return or get a refund?
body: Request cancellation from the order as soon as possible. A request is not confirmation that dispatch has stopped. For eligible returns, notify us within seven calendar days after actual delivery. Faults, wrong items and longer purchase-time promises have separate protection. Read the full policy before sending an item back.

sections.title: How do I follow up or escalate?
body: Account holders can follow their order-linked issue and support cases in their account. Guests can open Support Center with their order details. To track a guest case, use its case reference and the verification requested on the tracking page. Reply in the existing case rather than opening duplicates. If unresolved, ask DigitalHood to review it.

sections.title: Account, safety and seller help
body: Use password recovery if you cannot sign in. Report suspicious listings, impersonation, unexpected order emails or account activity to support. Keep payment and order conversations on DigitalHood. Sellers use Seller Center for applications, listings and orders; a rejected application can be corrected without creating a second account.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds Policy
returns.subtitle: A clear seven-day return window after delivery, with fair review, secure refunds and protection for faulty or incorrect items.
highlights: Request an eligible return within 7 calendar days after actual delivery; you do not need to complete the return shipment within that request window.
Faulty, damaged, unsafe, counterfeit or incorrectly supplied items are not subject to a blanket seven-day cutoff.
Existing orders with the earlier 14-day DigitalHood promise or a longer seller promise keep that protection.

sections.title: 1. The seven-day return window
body: For eligible change-of-mind returns on new purchases made under this policy after publication, contact us within seven calendar days after you actually receive the item. Delivery day is day zero; the window ends at 23:59 Africa/Lusaka time on day seven. For separate deliveries, count from receipt of each affected item, not the date you paid or ordered.

An earlier purchase keeps the return period promised at checkout, including DigitalHood's earlier 14-day policy. Any longer seller promise or applicable consumer right remains valid. If the delivery date or applicable policy is disputed or unclear, support will review the evidence rather than automatically reject the request.

sections.title: 2. Eligible items and condition
body: For change of mind, return the same item, complete with its supplied accessories, manuals, gifts and identifying serial numbers, without damage or use beyond reasonable inspection. Keep the original packaging where possible. Do not remove identifying labels, repair, modify or continue using a product you intend to return.

Made-to-order or personalised goods, perishable goods, activated or supplied digital content, completed services and opened sealed hygiene-sensitive items may be excluded from change-of-mind returns where disclosed before purchase. These exclusions do not remove remedies for faults, misdescription, non-delivery or other applicable rights. Opening packaging to discover a fault does not by itself invalidate a claim.

sections.title: 3. Wrong, damaged, faulty or unsafe items
body: Report the issue as soon as you discover it, preferably within seven days of delivery. Fault reports within 30 days receive priority review, but 30 days is not a denial cutoff. Warranty terms and applicable Zambian consumer rights may protect you for longer.

Stop using an unsafe item. Photograph the item, packaging and problem where safe; retain the delivery packaging and supplied contents. Missing an unboxing video does not automatically invalidate a claim. Do not post damaged batteries or hazardous goods until support supplies safe instructions.

sections.title: 4. How to request a return
body: Open My orders, select the purchase and choose Report an issue or the available return/refund action. Identify the affected items and quantities, the reason and your preferred remedy. Guests can use Support Center or contact contact@digitalhood.info / +260971047570 with the order number and purchase evidence.

Support records the request and coordinates with the seller. Keep the case reference. Wait for the confirmed return destination, transport arrangements and handover deadline before sending anything. Do not send to a seller's advertised address or DigitalHood office without return instructions.

sections.title: 5. Return transport and inspection
body: For confirmed wrong, damaged, defective or misdescribed goods, the responsible seller or DigitalHood covers reasonable approved return transport; support confirms arrangements first. For change of mind, the buyer normally pays the agreed return transport unless the listing or order promised free returns. Keep the handover receipt and tracking evidence.

The returned item is checked against the order, reported problem and condition. Any concern must be explained with evidence and an opportunity for you to respond. A delayed seller response does not erase a request submitted on time. Collection, inspection, remedy approval and payment are separate stages.

sections.title: 6. Full refunds, partial refunds and replacements
body: A full refund covers the qualifying amount actually paid for the affected goods and applicable tax. A partial refund must identify the exact affected items or agreed remedy; you do not have to accept a partial refund instead of a remedy you are entitled to. Repair or replacement depends on the circumstances, availability and your applicable rights.

Original delivery charges are assessed using the purchased delivery group and reason for return. A full qualifying delivery-group return includes its paid delivery share, including premium delivery; free shipping remains zero. An unaffected seller's goods are not automatically cancelled. There is no customer processing, administration or restocking deduction, or retrospective removal of a purchase discount.

sections.title: 7. How and when refunds are paid
body: Seller approval or a DigitalHood dispute decision authorises the remedy; it does not mean money has already been sent. DigitalHood Finance handles the approved refund with payment verification. Refunds go through the verified original payment route where supported; any necessary alternative is agreed and securely verified. Cash-on-delivery purchases need confirmed payment evidence and agreed repayment instructions.

Your case will distinguish review, approved, processing and paid outcomes. The case team confirms the expected timing for your payment route; bank or mobile-money posting times may differ. A screenshot, reference typed by staff or seller promise is not proof of a completed transfer. Never pay a fee or disclose a PIN, OTP or password to receive a refund.

sections.title: 8. Cancellation before delivery
body: Request cancellation promptly from your order. Cancellation is subject to confirmation that the affected goods have not been physically dispatched; preparing an order or printing a label is not by itself dispatch. Already dispatched goods follow the delivery/return process. A cancellation request does not itself confirm cancellation or refund payment.

sections.title: 9. Review, complaints and your rights
body: If the seller declines, does not respond or you disagree with the assessment, ask DigitalHood to review the existing case. We consider the order, delivery and payment records, listing, messages and evidence from both sides. Ask for the reason and a further review if relevant evidence was missed.

This policy does not exclude applicable Zambian consumer rights or a valid manufacturer/seller warranty. If an issue remains unresolved after contacting us, you may seek assistance from the Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (CCPC) or another appropriate authority.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
shipping.subtitle: Delivery coverage, charges, tracking, receipt and what to do when something goes wrong.
highlights: Delivery options, charges and the available estimate are shown for your address before checkout confirmation.
Different sellers or items may arrive separately. A delivery estimate is not confirmation of dispatch.

sections.title: Coverage, cost and estimates
body: DigitalHood serves delivery locations in Zambia supported at checkout. Coverage, delivery or collection options and charges depend on your address, seller, product and carrier. Check the final fee and estimate before paying; do not assume every product qualifies for free or same-day delivery. Contact support before ordering if your location is unavailable.

An estimate can be affected by stock checks, payment confirmation, weekends, public holidays, weather or carrier disruption. Any revised arrangement should be communicated through your order or support case.

sections.title: Dispatch and multiple sellers
body: An order acknowledgement, payment receipt, packed status or printed label does not prove the carrier has collected the goods. Track the available fulfilment events on your order. Items from multiple sellers may use separate deliveries and tracking details; check each item before reporting the entire order missing.

sections.title: Your delivery details and collection
body: Provide an accurate delivery address, reachable phone number and helpful directions. Request corrections promptly through the order; rerouting cannot be guaranteed after dispatch. Any additional charge must be explained and agreed, not collected unexpectedly.

Where collection is offered, wait for the ready-for-collection confirmation and instructions. Keep your order reference and follow the identity/authorised-collector checks. An office address is not automatically a collection or return point.

sections.title: Receiving and checking goods
body: Check the parcel and contents promptly. Record visible damage, missing contents or tampering and tell the delivery agent where practical. Keep packaging and delivery evidence until you have checked the items. Do not use an unsafe product. Signing for a parcel does not remove your right to report a concealed fault or incorrect item.

sections.title: Late, lost, incomplete or disputed delivery
body: If the estimate has passed, a parcel is missing or tracking says delivered when it was not received, report it from the order. We coordinate seller/carrier checks and assess delivery evidence. Do not confirm receipt of goods you have not received. If fulfilment cannot be completed, the case is reviewed for an appropriate replacement or refund.
If a delivery attempt fails, contact support to agree the next step. Any redelivery cost depends on the cause and the arrangement disclosed to you; it must not be invented after the event.

sections.title: Cancellation and returns
body: Request cancellation before physical dispatch wherever possible; wait for confirmation. Dispatched goods use the delivery and returns process. The return-request period starts from actual receipt of the affected item, not checkout or a delivery estimate. Follow confirmed return instructions rather than sending parcels to an unverified address.

warranty.title: Warranty & Repairs Policy
warranty.subtitle: How to check product cover, report a fault and arrange an assessed repair, replacement or refund.
highlights: Warranty length and scope depend on the product and the seller/manufacturer promise shown when you buy.
The seven-day change-of-mind return window does not end a valid warranty or applicable consumer rights.

sections.title: Check cover before buying
body: Read the listing for product condition, warranty provider, duration, covered parts and any disclosed limits. New, refurbished and used products may have different stated cover. Ask for clarification before purchase if details are missing. A brand name or marketplace listing does not by itself promise a manufacturer warranty or a particular duration.

sections.title: How to make a claim
body: Open the order and report the fault, when it began and the affected item or serial number. Include purchase evidence and useful photos or a short description of troubleshooting already tried. Guests may use Support Center. Keep the item and accessories available for assessment; support will confirm where and how it should be handed over.

sections.title: Safe assessment and data
body: Stop using a product that is overheating, swollen, smoking or otherwise unsafe. Do not open, repair or ship unsafe batteries without instructions. For devices, back up your data and remove personal accounts or locks only when safely instructed; never send account passwords or payment credentials. Explain if damage prevents backup or safe access.

sections.title: What may be excluded
body: Ordinary wear, accidental/liquid damage, misuse, incompatible installation, consumables or unauthorised modification may fall outside a stated commercial warranty, depending on the disclosed terms and cause. A claim is assessed on evidence; an exclusion cannot be used to remove applicable rights for an original defect or misdescription. The reason for declining cover should be explained.

sections.title: Remedies, timing and charges
body: The outcome may be repair, replacement, refund or another agreed remedy, according to the fault, valid cover and applicable rights. Support confirms assessment arrangements and the expected next update; no universal repair completion time is promised. Any non-covered assessment, transport or repair charge must be explained and approved before chargeable work proceeds. Keep the service/job reference and do not accept an unexplained charge.

sections.title: If the issue is unresolved
body: Follow up in the existing order or support case with the service reference. If you disagree with the diagnosis or remedy, ask DigitalHood for review and provide any new evidence. Manufacturer support can assist where valid, but it does not remove the responsible seller's applicable obligations.
